records.name: Evil Blast
records.character_source: Dabura, Omega Shenron customizable partner, Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) customizable partner, and Super Baby 2 customizable partner documented by current references
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 114 — The Majin Revival Plan
records.skill_description: Become translucent briefly and counter a strike by teleporting behind the opponent and firing a powerful Ki Blast.
records.mechanics_notes: Current DBXV2 documentation classifies Evil Blast as a strike counter that transitions into a teleporting Ki Blast projectile. The counter window lasts about two seconds; when struck by a melee/strike attack during the window, the user teleports behind the opponent and fires the projectile. The current reference describes a 15-hit knockback sequence.
